notes.title: Ashen Knights: Foreshadow - Sharing Our Future Plans!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Valiant Knights![/h2]

[h3]We would like to remind you that Ashen Knights: Foreshadow is now available in Early Access! We will continue to support it and release regular updates. Don't forget that your participation and feedback are crucial to us. Together, we are creating the world of Ashen Knights and making it even more captivating!

By the way, we have plans to release 6 more chapters of the story campaign, 2 boss battles, and 1 mini-boss battle. So get ready for even more intense battles and adventures in the world of Ashen Knights: Foreshadow![/h3]

notes.title: Ashen Knights: Foreshadow. Early Access Release!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Valiant Knights![/h2]

[h3]With great excitement, we announce that Ashen Knights: Foreshadow is finally available in Early Access! This moment has become possible thanks to the efforts of our development team, who have invested hundreds of hours of work and boundless passion into creating a new incredible world in the souls-like & hack’n’slash genre. We are proud to present to you the first three thrilling chapters of the story Campaign and four Unique Boss Battles!

But this is only the beginning of our journey! We promise to continue our work, gathering and analyzing your feedback and comments to make Ashen Knights: Foreshadow even better and more unique. Together, we will create not just a game, but a true adventure, full of excitement, thrilling battles, and emotions!

We thank you for your support and loyalty. Don't miss the opportunity to immerse yourself in this fantastic world and become part of the incredible story of Ashen Knights: Foreshadow![/h3]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008200/Ashen_Knights_Foreshadow/]Link - Ashen Knights: Foreshadow [/url][/h1]
